nodes.name: Set up Grid in a location.
nodes.text: ## Set up Grid in a location.

nodes.name: Grid is in early access. Workspace owners and admins set…
nodes.text: Grid is in early access. Workspace owners and admins set up Grid in a location—the workspace root, a product or a project—and become its first manager. Managers grant **reader**, **editor** or **manager** roles to members from **Settings → Member access**, in the location’s access dialog. Workspace administration and Memory access do not grant Grid access.

nodes.name: Grid holds folders, pages and reusable templates, plus a…
nodes.text: Grid holds folders, pages and reusable templates, plus a Grid-only **Assets** library for images, video, audio and fonts. Start a page from a starter, a saved template or a copy of another page. Each page has its own layout and up to twelve breakpoints; editing a template never changes existing pages until you apply it again.

nodes.name: Pages can only use Grid assets from the same location.…
nodes.text: Pages can only use Grid assets from the same location. Upload files of up to 10 MiB to the Grid assets library; Memory assets are a separate library and never appear in Grid.

nodes.name: Null is available on the right of the editor, with Read…
nodes.text: Null is available on the right of the editor, with Read and Work modes. External agents need the connection’s separate Grid capability—none, read or edit—and a Grid role in the location. Agents save private drafts like any editor. They cannot publish.

nodes.name: A content pool connects a unique public key to a folder…
nodes.text: A content pool connects a unique public key to a folder and everything in it. Grid managers create and edit pools under **Content pools**: name, key, folder and whether the pool is enabled. Only pages explicitly published into a pool appear in its API, and disabling a pool hides all of its published pages. A pool can only be deleted once it has no publications.

nodes.name: Save your changes first. Then open **Publish**, choose a…
nodes.text: Save your changes first. Then open **Publish**, choose a content pool, and set the **Page slug**, **Content language** and **Summary**. You can add a **Cover image (optional)** with an image description; leave the description empty for a decorative image. Choose **Publish saved version**.

nodes.name: Publishing makes that saved version and the assets it uses…
nodes.text: Publishing makes that saved version and the assets it uses public. Later edits stay private until you publish again. **Unpublish** withdraws the page and its assets. Publishing is a browser action for Grid managers only.
